name: Velvet Antenna v0.20.4 Standalone
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna release. v0.20.4 fixes duplicate filtering so unresolved cards cannot leak into duplicate results, requires corroborating title evidence for provider-ID matches, and retains Needs ID, native multi-select, playback, Series/Season and metadata-management functionality.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.21.4 Velvet Lens
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna redesign focused on speed and a distinct browsing identity. v0.21.4 uses a fresh mod ID and physical asset filenames to defeat stale JellyFrame caching, exposes inline IDENTIFY in the Needs ID workbench, resolution badges plus confirmed DELETE in the Duplicate workbench, removes the remaining visible native Jellyfin library header/tab chrome, and retains the detail PLAY/CONTINUE control.
